claims: San Francisco Giants opened the 2026 MLB season with a 7-0 home loss to the New York Yankees
The game was on Wednesday, March 25, 2026
The game was at Oracle Park, San Francisco, CA
Logan Webb allowed seven runs (six earned) over five innings
San Francisco Giants offense had three hits
The game was exclusively streamed on Netflix
New York Yankees 7, San Francisco Giants 0
Starting pitchers were Logan Webb (SF) vs. Max Fried (NYY)
The game was the first MLB game streamed exclusively on Netflix
Logan Webb gave up five runs in the second inning
Logan Webb threw an 85 mph changeup to Giancarlo Stanton that started a rally
San Francisco Giants offense was shut out
The game marked the first game for the San Francisco Giants under new management
San Francisco Giants have further games scheduled for early April against the Mets and Phillies
